title: Dissipation-protected energy storage in interacting multilevel quantum batteries
summary: Dark and subradiant states have emerged as a promising resource for stabilizing open quantum batteries against dissipation, but existing studies are largely limited to qubit ensembles and symmetry-based constructions. Here we introduce a systematic, thermodynamically consistent framework for identifying long-lived energy storage states in interacting multilevel quantum batteries, combining the Davies master equation with a Morris-Shore (MS)-type decomposition of dissipative coupling blocks.
